blind.description: A stylized domed masonry kiln consisting of a low circular stone foundation ring, a beehive-shaped body of reddish-orange brick and plaster reinforced by two dark metal bands, a small arched opening at the front leading to a hollow interior, and a cylindrical open flue/chimney collar at the apex. The surfaces are solid, continuous, and cleanly modeled with hand-painted textures; no unattached or floating parts, and no fire or internal glow.
blind.from_above: Concentric rings: a dark round opening in the center surrounded by an orange clay lip, a tapering brick dome ringed by two dark metal bands, and an outer dark stone base edge, with the top of the arched entrance projecting slightly at the bottom.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 4.5 to 5.0 feet tall (noticeably shorter than the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 4.5 feet wide in diameter.
